svg.title: Full-grid limits
svg.desc: Only 3 of 15 paired cells per route were fully eligible. There were 27 budget-aborted cells (24 baseline, three candidate), 11 setup/cell errors, three control failures and 35,509 planned/measured failures across 58,560 planned measured tasks. Candidate completed 21,600/29,280 planned measured tasks; baseline completed 1,451/29,280. Candidate’s three matched-WebKit 32-worker cells exceeded the 2 GiB family limit during setup; the simpler 32-client semantic grid is a distinct result.
